Beese Fulmer Investment Management Has Upped Its Texas Instrs Com (TXN) Stake by $448,344 as Valuation Declined; Vigilant Capital Management Has Trimmed Its Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co LTD (TSM) Position by $355,914; Market Value Rose
May 15, 2018 - By Darrin Black
Beese Fulmer Investment Management Inc increased its stake in Texas Instrs Inc Com (TXN) by 34.04% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Beese Fulmer Investment Management Inc bought 4,311 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.51% with the market. The institutional investor held 16,976 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.77 million, up from 12,665 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Beese Fulmer Investment Management Inc who had been investing in Texas Instrs Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $106.88B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.60% or $1.77 during the last trading session, reaching $108.87. About 2.41M shares traded. Texas Instruments Incorporated (NASDAQ:TXN) has risen 27.36% since May 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 15.81% the S&P500.
Vigilant Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co Ltd (TSM) by 3.04% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Vigilant Capital Management Llc sold 9,126 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.24% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 291,549 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $11.56M, down from 300,675 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Vigilant Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $199.67B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.83% or $0.73 during the last trading session, reaching $39.22. About 3.62M shares traded. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (NYSE:TSM) has risen 30.51% since May 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 18.96% the S&P500.
Vigilant Capital Management Llc, which manages about $610.61 million and $760.48 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Us Bancorp (NYSE:USB) by 12,403 shares to 442,540 shares, valued at $23.71 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 19,324 shares in the quarter, for a total of 116,845 shares, and has risen its stake in Commerce Bancshares Inc (NASDAQ:CBSH).
